findings.problem: The bundle-secret scan still hard-codes src/ (test -d src/, grep src/); plan Slot inventory row :71 said it reads app_roots; ship.md is now kit code, overwritten and denied, so an app_roots project (EcoCrew: frontend/src) cannot restore its adaptation.
findings.scenario: EcoCrew-shaped project (app_roots [frontend]) upgrades: ship.md overwritten; every /loop:ship prints SCAN NOT RUN: no src/ and the VITE_* secret scan never covers the app again, with no local remedy.
findings.closure: The ship.md fence computes its directories from project.json app_roots (<root>/src per root, src/ when empty) with no literal src/ operand left; a contract case pins app_roots [frontend] → the scan greps frontend/src and does not print SCAN NOT RUN.

findings.problem: react-query.md's gateway example imports @/lib/client with no instruction to use data_client.module; step 7 removed wire_supabase's rewrite of this file and client-copies is skip in installed mode, so nothing replaces it (feature.md and fixtures.md got the sentence).
findings.scenario: install.sh --supabase → an agent follows react-query.md's SSE gateway → imports @/lib/client, a module that does not exist (the client is lib/supabase).
findings.closure: react-query.md carries the sentence replace @/lib/client by the data_client.module of .claude/project.json next to its gateway example; a contract case asserts it.

findings.problem: PK18's awk over init.md takes the first N. line in the file (Phase 1 items 2 and 9), never Phase 3 steps 2 and 9; its kit-backup grep is file-wide, already satisfied by Phase 3 step 14.
findings.scenario: Edit init.md Phase 3 step 9 to write the components section of .claude/skills/patterns/feedback.md, or drop .claude/kit-backup/ from the Port phase → PK18 stays green.
findings.closure: PK18 scopes the step extraction to ## Phase 3 and the kit-backup grep to the ## Phase 4 — Port section; both mutations above turn PK18 red (pure added assertions, recorded as a Gate amendment).

findings.problem: kp_prompt_paths (PK18 ADAPTATION half, PK20) flags a path only when it exists as a core kit file, narrower than the plan line and Vigilance Q11 (every four-dir path is prefixed by .claude/overlays/); addon-only prompts are never flagged.
findings.scenario: Add write your backend gate in .claude/commands/backend/audit.md to addons/fastapi/README.md §3 → PK20 stays green while an installed fastapi project denies that write.
findings.closure: kp_prompt_paths also resolves addon prompts (addons/*/<rel>), so the scenario above turns PK20 red; recorded as a Gate amendment.

findings.problem: A project upgraded from before this pass (no manifest) re-run without its addon flag records none of that addon's prompts in .claude/kit-manifest (99 → 84 entries); fixed by the next run with the flag.
findings.scenario: EcoCrew upgraded with --no-ci and no --fastapi: fastapi-only prompts unlisted, writable.

findings.problem: copy_kit now overwrites a kit prompt through a symlinked prompt dir pointing outside the target (base wrote .new there); backup kept, overwrite is the planned contract; report it in the summary.
findings.scenario: .claude/skills → ../team3/skills: install.sh replaces the shared feedback.md, edit only in kit-backup.

findings.problem: Rule 3 with a missing destination still lists the path in the manifest (kit-doctor MISSING kit-manifest that install.sh cannot fix) and does not name it in the summary.

findings.problem: When only prompts changed the summary prints kit code: up to date right above the prompts adaptés block; stale comment at :881 about wire_supabase rewriting templates.

findings.problem: Port reads every backup run since the last Port with no record of the last Port; init Phase 3 writes no step for the deploy, extra-gates, probes, migrations, field-schemas, coverage-globs overlay sections (only the audit grep surfaces them).

findings.problem: Known limits: the manifest is read from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR only (worktree on a newer kit), physical-path and case limits, frontmatter name shadowing of a kit prompt, shell guard 3.6 s vs 5 s timeout with 121 entries; the deny text names LoopKit, not the overlay (audit/part.md:27, rules-index.md:27 still route an installed project to a kit prompt edit).
findings.scenario: Agent denied on a kit prompt is sent to LoopKit instead of .claude/overlays/<path>.
